item.title: 2026-11-18 — Nvidia beats after Wall Street slide, UK inflation hits 3.6%, Iran-US strikes in the Gulf
item.description:
Nvidia's first results since Jensen Huang's exit beat forecasts after the S&P 500 closed at its lowest since July. UK inflation rose to 3.6% in October on record diesel prices. Iran and the US traded strikes around Bahrain and Qeshm ahead of Thursday's Trump-Xi-Putin meeting. Plus Visa's third-party incident, an exploited Puppet flaw, England's win in Madrid and Pochettino's first day at Manchester United.
